subagent_inputs.name: Gap detection + vessel-forge decision from executor POV

gap_taxonomy.name: missing-resolver
gap_taxonomy.signal: runtime.resolvers.get(task.resolver) undefined AND not in attachedVessels

gap_taxonomy.name: missing-vessel-attachment
gap_taxonomy.signal: not in runtime.resolvers but is in attachedVessels — retry via passthrough

gap_taxonomy.name: missing-shape-in-pool
gap_taxonomy.signal: declaredInputShapeNames not subset of pool.shapes; already computed at lifecycle:task:preBinding engine.ts:88-94

gap_taxonomy.name: shape-ambiguity
gap_taxonomy.signal: ≥2 producers, Thompson margin < ε; defer to slot-binding NOT a gap

gap_taxonomy.name: synthesis-failure
gap_taxonomy.signal: resolver fired, empty output OR failure_mode.type=verifier_negative

decision_rule_forge_vs_dispatch_vs_hitl.synthesis-failure (LLM refuses with adeq: HITL or single re-prompt with richer context — NEVER forge (forge gives capability, not judgment)
decision_rule_forge_vs_dispatch_vs_hitl.missing-shape-in-pool (producers exist): DISPATCH create-shape-provider-goal with candidate set as hint

forge_gating_conditions_all_required: within per-day forge budget AND per-shape limit of 1
concept-db has some prior on this shape (description_of or partial resolver_pattern)
originating goal endpoint_output_shapes covers proposed forge output (CC1)

concept_db_conditioning_gate.resolver_pattern_present: dispatch with that sequence as hint (playbook IS the answer)
concept_db_conditioning_gate.description_of_present_but_no_resolver_p: strong forge signal — documented but unimplemented capability
concept_db_conditioning_gate.both_empty: HITL safer than forge (no prior to ground new vessel's design)
